title: Outrider 307 by AvantStay | Close to Broadway
description:
- 10-15 minutes to all the excitement of Broadway and Downtown Nashville
- Two bedrooms, king bedroom has an ensuite bathroom
- Bunk room for extra space and flexibility
- Bright and open living and dining area
- Curated, Nashville-inspired design and decor
- Fully equipped kitchen with a full suite of appliances

The space
Outrider is your key to experiencing Nashville like never before. Just a 10-15-minute rideshare away from Downtown and Broadway, you'll have access to all the city's excitement against the backdrop of a cool, curated design worthy of all your aesthetic dreams.

This two-bedroom apartment has a spacious, airy layout perfect for a group looking to connect and explore the city. You’ll find chic, Nashville-inspired design and a vibrant, playful atmosphere. The living room has a sofa and TV ready for movie nights, while the fully equipped kitchen boasts a full suite of appliances and everything you need to make at-home meals and snacks a breeze. There's seating for 4 at the dining table and additional barstool seating at the island counter.

Two bedrooms give everyone plenty of space to spread out. The primary king room has an ensuite bathroom, and the second bedroom offers a bunk bed perfect for kids or groups of friends.

It's time to unlock Nashville as it was meant to be experienced. Outrider is ready to show you the city while treating you to style, convenience, and all the comforts of home.

Please note the layout and design may differ from what is showcased in the photos. For any queries please do not hesitate to reach out.

East Nashville is one of Nashville's oldest neighborhoods, located just across the Cumberland River. Known for its eclectic and artsy atmosphere, you'll find some of the city's best restaurants, live music venues, shopping, and easy access to Nissan Stadium. Bonus: all of the excitement of Broadway is just a 10-minute Uber drive away. Don't be surprised if you see one of your favorite musicians walking around this neighborhood, as many of them call it home!

Experience Nashville, AvantStay style.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

Other things to note
Home Truths:
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- There are 3 flights of stairs present within the unit. Please note this unit may not be suitable for guests with mobility issues.

Parking Details:
1 parking space is allowed per unit. 
Street parking is available.
Please note: Vehicles must be parked only in approved areas to avoid towing.

  - Occupancy and noise limits are strongly enforced. Subject to fines that can reach up to $10,000 per violation.
